title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre - Stanford University on 1982-10-09
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/88.2k) -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB) Sony ECM-220T -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Fuji Metal Tape/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: Rich front‑of‑house (soundboard) recording captures an average 1982 show with balanced instruments and solid Jerry vocals.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the close‑up, full‑bodied FOB mix – clear bass, well‑balanced instruments and a dream‑like sound for audiophiles. The performance itself is deemed merely average, though Jerry’s guitar tone and vocals are highlighted as better than usual for that year.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed reviews consistently praise an excellent recording (5 & 4 stars) while noting the show is only average, yielding a strong overall rating weighted toward the superb sound quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Close‑up FOB mix with rich tone, full bass without boom or distortion, and well‑balanced instruments – an audiophile’s dream.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific setlist comments; reviewer describes the overall performance as average despite a few strong moments from Jerry.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Jerry's guitar and vocals are noted as relatively good and half‑way decent for this period.
